Classical choices support a symbolic real operator, not an executable floating-point algorithm.

implementation.scope: Related finite fixed-core perturbation bound, not a general noisy-coordinate learner

reviewed_scope: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert spaces, with the spectral operator norm. The smallest row singular value is represented by the infimum of adjoint norm ratios, proved equal to the infimum on unit vectors. Strict input error below this value derives surjectivity and the norm of the constructed orthogonal pseudoinverse. The full residual identity and divided bound are derived. Coordinates and dimension are fixed. No fitted-basis or statistical error is absorbed without a bound.
